items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: The interviewer addresses the interviewee as 'Tance' ('Is he still playing, Tance?'). The interviewee responds to questions about a third person ('He plays around...'). There is no evidence in the transcript that the interviewee (Tance) has a personal relationship with the person named 'Tance' other

ctx.x: Yeah. Johnny rent them a room. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Is he still playing, Tance? Huh? Is he still playing?
He plays around. He plays around a little around California. He plays a little around California.
